# BlackSwan x402 Smart Agents

Risk intelligence APIs powered by the x402 payment protocol on Base Mainnet.

## Available Agents

| Agent | Price | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| flare | $0.01 | Precursor Detection - Catches risk signals before events materialize |
| core | $0.03 | State Synthesis - Synthesizes market state from multiple data sources |

## Payment Details

- **Network**: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453)
- **Asset**: USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- **Pay To**: 0x154b1006435e5cfe2206e7777c1003f9438119b1

## Usage

All endpoints accept POST requests with JSON body. Send request without payment to receive 402 response with payment requirements.
